title: Capability discovery API
description: Implement and validate lichen_hal_capabilities_get(), lichen_hal_has_capability(), and lichen_hal_identity_get() APIs. Ensure all 10 capability flags (LORA, BLE_LOCAL, SERIAL_LOCAL, GNSS, BATTERY, PMIC, BUTTONS, LEDS, DISPLAY, EXTERNAL_FLASH) work correctly with Kconfig/devicetree binding.
close_reason: Already fixed - all three APIs (lichen_hal_capabilities_get, lichen_hal_has_capability, lichen_hal_identity_get) are fully implemented in hal_caps.c with BUILD_ASSERTs enforcing Kconfig/devicetree binding, and comprehensive tests exist in tests/hal/src/main.c
